remainingActualLimits: IFRS Foundation PDF access itself remains restricted; equivalent cited requirements were checked in freely accessible official adopted text without bypassing access controls.
Dated adopted text supports the specified teaching claims, not certification of every later amendment or jurisdiction/reporting-period applicability.
The original planning paper does not substantiate a guaranteed accuracy improvement from recalling prior work; parent was given a targeted qualification.
